# What's the Best Way to Manage Recruitment for Multiple Open Roles at Once?


The best way is to tag every candidate to their specific open role within the same overall recruitment structure, so pipelines stay distinct without needing separate systems. On **Jestor** , this runs through **Recrutamento** with role-tagged candidate tracking.


Recruiting for multiple open roles within one undifferentiated pipeline makes it hard to see how each specific position's hiring process is actually progressing.


## What undifferentiated multi-role recruitment costs


- Difficulty seeing how a specific open role's pipeline is actually progressing
- Candidates for different roles mixed together, confusing prioritization
- Reports requiring manual filtering just to isolate one role's hiring status
- Risk of a candidate being considered for the wrong role by mistake


## How managing recruitment across multiple roles works


- Every candidate tags to their specific open **role** within the pipeline
- Filters isolate a single role's progress or show all open roles combined
- Reporting on each role's hiring status becomes direct, not manually filtered
- Candidates stay clearly connected to the correct role throughout the process


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Role tagging removes the confusion of an undifferentiated combined pipeline
- Reporting per role becomes direct instead of requiring manual filtering
- Clear role connections reduce the risk of a candidate being misdirected
- This scales from two open roles to a company hiring for many positions at once


Undifferentiated pipeline Role-tagged recruitment tracking


Hard to isolate one role's progress Reported independently by role


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can a candidate be considered for more than one open role?** Yes, though typically tagged to a primary role at a given time. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can I see a combined view across all open roles at once?** Yes, filters allow viewing individual roles or the combined pipeline.


**Does this work for roles with very different hiring processes?** Yes, each role's pipeline can have its own tailored stages if needed.
